name: Radio group
description: A set of native radio buttons for choosing exactly one option, with a legend.

props.name: legend
props.description: Visible name of the group, rendered as a <legend>.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value, for a controlled group.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value selected first, for an uncontrolled group.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when the selection changes.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Generated when omitted.

a11y: Native radios in a <fieldset> with a <legend>, so arrow keys move the selection and the group is announced.
Each option has a real <label>; descriptions are linked with aria-describedby.
The selected option is shown by a filled circle, not color alone.
